title: Google and NASA's Quantum Artificial Intelligence Lab
summary: A short Google video introducing the Quantum AI Lab, a partnership between Google, NASA, USRA and a 512-qubit D-Wave Two quantum computer. It covers the lab's early goals and some potential applications of quantum computing.
why: HN mostly cites it as a reference for the Google/NASA/D-Wave partnership and as a basic intro to quantum computing's potential.

quote.text: It talks about some cool potential applications and attempts to break down the very basics.
